title: 12. Como lidar com mulheres que fogem

queries.text: Nietzsche, Thus Spoke Zarathustra, “Of Old and Young Women,” translated from the author’s Portuguese. Thomas Common’s public-domain version reads: “The happiness of man is, ‘I will.’ The happiness of woman is, ‘He will.’” Kept “want” to follow the author’s “quero/quer.”
